` 卡片），阅读页把回答正文交给它，思考、折叠和过程动效仍由阅读页负责。详见 [官方能力接入说明](docs/official-rendering-bridge.md)。 另一个插件可以在展示层改写思考和回答（例如翻译），阅读页仍负责浮现、跟随和折叠。复制的是原文，会话记录不变。契约和最小例子见 [扩展点](docs/extension-points.md)。 ``` **依据 2 · 源码核查**：[src/client/index.tsx:79-90](https://github.com/aa2246740/dsh-better-display/blob/2bfb1a63ac332d8d2032485ea9b182022edd9e78/src/client/index.tsx#L79-L90) 注册独立阅读视图
查看原文（12行） ```text ctx.slots.inject('conversation.chat.node', function* () { yield ctx.slots.register({ name: 'conversation.view', id: 'reader', order: -5, label: () => '阅读', locale: 'chat', children: { 'dsh-better-display.block': { kind: 'chain', scope: 'session' }, ...officialChildren(ctx.slots as unknown as CompositionRegistry), }, store, ```
#### 缺口 - 更少滚动不能牺牲错误可见性。 **影响**：减少过程淹没最终回答。 **进一步探讨**：固定长轮次对照。 ### Q02 · 怎样判断完成？ **研究主题**：功能与机制、工程质量与复用 #### 完整回答 投影只在 assistant settled、边界 closed 且 reason completed 时判定可折叠正文；新正文或工具结束不足以判整个轮次完成。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[src/client/projection.ts:37-51](https://github.com/aa2246740/dsh-better-display/blob/2bfb1a63ac332d8d2032485ea9b182022edd9e78/src/client/projection.ts#L37-L51) 结束和折叠条件
查看原文（15行） ```text * A settled body step before the closing step of a successful turn. * * This is presentation classification only. Narration is never process content * and never folds. The flag only marks body text that is no longer the turn's * final answer, so copy and fork stay on that final answer. */ export function isEarlierNarration(data: AssistantChatData, boundary: TurnBoundary): boolean { // New body text, a tool call, or a settled step is not a completed turn. if (data.status !== 'settled' || boundary.status !== 'closed' || boundary.reason !== 'completed') return false; if (data.blocks.some(block => block.kind === 'image' || block.kind === 'other')) return false; return boundary.closingStep !== null && data.step < boundary.closingStep; } export function processExpanded(choice: boolean | undefined, boundary: TurnBoundary): boolean { return choice ?? !(boundary.status === 'closed' && boundary.reason === 'completed'); ```
**依据 2 · 源码核查**：[src/client/live-turn.ts:19-39](https://github.com/aa2246740/dsh-better-display/blob/2bfb1a63ac332d8d2032485ea9b182022edd9e78/src/client/live-turn.ts#L19-L39) 运行中折叠及摘要
查看原文（21行） ```text export function liveFoldEnabled(boundary: TurnBoundary): boolean { return boundary.status === 'open'; } export function foldSummary(steps: readonly LiveStep[]): string { let reasoning = 0; let body = 0; let tool = 0; let extra = 0; for (const step of steps) { if (step.kind === 'reasoning') reasoning += 1; else if (step.kind === 'body') body += 1; else if (step.kind === 'tool') tool += 1; else if (step.kind !== 'user') extra += 1; } const parts: string[] = []; if (reasoning) parts.push(`思考×${reasoning}`); if (body) parts.push(`输出×${body}`); if (tool) parts.push(`工具×${tool}`); if (extra) parts.push(`记录×${extra}`); return parts.join(' · ') || '此前步骤'; ```
#### 缺口 - 宿主边界状态需验证。 **影响**：失败和取消应保留诊断。 **进一步探讨**：测试成功、失败和取消。 ### Q03 · 渲染扩展边界？ **研究主题**：缺陷与关键质疑 #### 完整回答 自定义文本转换服务和官方子插槽在阅读视图中组合。其他插件可变更展示，复制原文与显示文本需核对一致性说明。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[src/client/index.tsx:68-88](https://github.com/aa2246740/dsh-better-display/blob/2bfb1a63ac332d8d2032485ea9b182022edd9e78/src/client/index.tsx#L68-L88) 文本转换和官方 children

One root instance keeps glass, fold // intensity, and open-mode on the unsuffixed `dsh.reader.v1` key. const prefs = store.create(); installBetterDisplaySettings(ctx, prefs); ctx.slots.inject('conversation.chat.node', function* () { yield ctx.slots.register({ name: 'conversation.view', id: 'reader', order: -5, label: () => '阅读', locale: 'chat', children: { 'dsh-better-display.block': { kind: 'chain', scope: 'session' }, ...officialChildren(ctx.slots as unknown as CompositionRegistry), ```
